title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1985-03-25
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Recording and transfer by Andrew F. 05/2015
source: AUD: Beyers M88's > lead deck Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's, with no Dolby, set up in second row of seats at end of the floor.

ai_review.summary: Clear, punchy soundboard recording with a fluid Garcia opener (Jack Straw → Sugaree) after successful noise attenuation.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for being punchy and clear once the pedal‑battery hum in Slipknot was attenuated. Garcia’s playing is highlighted as especially fluid during the Jack Straw into Sugaree opener, making this a standout musical moment despite the limited information on the rest of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review emphasizes excellent sound quality and strong performance, but with only one source confidence is low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noise from a battery in Garcia's pedal (heard during Slipknot) was successfully attenuated; overall mix described as punchy and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opener featuring Jack Straw into Sugaree flows smoothly; the clean recording lets Garcia’s fluid playing shine.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is noted for very fluid, punchy playing, especially on the opener.
